tasks.description: Zero-resource backup recoverability recheck after the current gated-horizon training-audit receipt repair passed structured gates. Nonzero controller/plant/solver work remains blocked until external backup status is verified. This task reads only supervisor backup status/proof artifacts and the latest backup request produced by the receipt repair, summarizes whether a verified recoverable backup now exists, and preserves the next-action decision. It does not open validation banks, run controllers/solvers/plant, train/refit, create validation episodes, or access sealed/final tests.
tasks.method: Zero-resource external-backup recoverability status capture after current gated-horizon audit receipt repair; read only backup status/proof/request artifacts and run registry/log context; determine whether nonzero source242/risk-reselection smoke work remains gated; no validation-bank source opening; no controller/plant/solver execution; no training/refit; no new validation episodes; no sealed/final test.

config_constraints.script_purpose: zero-resource backup gate recheck before any nonzero controller/solver/training work after the accepted current-gated audit receipt repair
config_constraints.next_action_if_backup_verified: publish and run a bounded nonzero smoke/controller-path measurement from the already prepared source242 or risk-reselection branch under explicit resource limits
config_constraints.next_action_if_backup_still_blocked: continue only zero-resource preparation/repair/state preservation; do not launch solver/plant/controller/training work
